A.question: What are Critical Actions?

answerFinal.text: In SAP GRC Access Control Access Risk Analysis, a Critical Action is a ruleset risk type that flags a single sensitive executable — typically a transaction, Web Dynpro, Fiori app, or service — as high risk on its own. It is not an S/4HANA role-transformation methodology and it is not the same as a segregation-of-duties Risk, which needs conflicting Functions together. Critical Action differs from Critical Permission: the Action layer checks the executable; Critical Permission checks a powerful authorization-object, field and value combination even when the Action itself looks ordinary. I keep Critical Action rules aligned to privileged operations the business cares about and triage those findings separately from SoD noise.
